title: Weather
settings.city.about: For /weather without a city and for “Send the weather” in the menu of the send button.
settings.usage: Type /weather and a city in any chat, or just /weather for the default city. The command itself is not sent.
error.no_city: Type /weather and a city, or set the default city in the plugin settings.
error.request: Could not get the weather for “{city}” ({problem}).
